description: PCL-N plugin project, manifest, Roslyn, build, package, and validation tooling for Community Edition
untrustedWorkspaces.description: PCL Community tooling requires a trusted workspace to run .NET build and package commands.
command.installCsharpLanguageServer: Install or Update C# Language Server
config.sdkVersion: Public PNPSDK version used by generated projects and diagnostics.
config.dotnetPath: Path or command name of the .NET SDK CLI.
config.csharpLsPath: Optional absolute path to csharp-ls. Leave empty to use the IDE-managed installation or PATH.
config.csharpLsAutoInstall: Install the pinned csharp-ls tool into the IDE user-data directory when a PCL plugin workspace is opened.
